gloss: the present age; current generation; current head (of a family or school)

definitions.gloss: the present age; current era; nowadays
definitions.explanation: The current period or era, used to talk about what is happening in the present time.

definitions.gloss: current head; present master (of a family, school, or lineage)
definitions.explanation: The person who currently holds the position of head in a family line, traditional art school, or similar hereditary succession.

examples.japanese: {当代|とうだい}⟦{随一|ずいいち}→随一：14534_zuiichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名人|めいじん}→名人：03753_meijin⟧だ。
examples.english: He is the foremost master of our time.

examples.japanese: {当代|とうだい}きって⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}→実力者：21845_jitsuryokusha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: He is said to be the most powerful figure of the present age.

examples.japanese: {当代|とうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧なし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}できない→生活する：01839_seikatsusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that young people of the current generation cannot live without smartphones.

examples.japanese: {当代|とうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家元|いえもと}→家元：12525_iemoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十五代目|じゅうごだいめ}だ。
examples.english: The current head of the school is the fifteenth generation.

examples.english: The current master took over the shop.

examples.english: The current family head is the son of the previous head and carefully preserves the traditions.

notes:
Has two distinct uses: referring to the current era (often in literary or formal expressions praising someone as the best of their time) and referring to the person currently heading a lineage or tradition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {当代|とうだい}⟦{随一|ずいいち}→随一：14534_zuiichi⟧: the foremost of our time
- {当代|とうだい}きって⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: the best/most of our time
- {当代|とうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名人|めいじん}→名人：03753_meijin⟧: master of the present age
- {当代|とうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家元|いえもと}→家元：12525_iemoto⟧: current head of a traditional school
- {当代|とうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{当主|とうしゅ}→当主：12765_toushu⟧: current family head

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧: modern times / the present day — the most common word for the current era
- ⟦{先代|せんだい}→先代：14793_sendai⟧: previous generation / predecessor — the person who held the position before the current one
- {次代|じだい}: next generation — the upcoming successor
- ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧: the current age — everyday equivalent of {当代|とうだい} in sense 1

REGISTER:
Formal/literary. {当代|とうだい}⟦{随一|ずいいち}→随一：14534_zuiichi⟧ and {当代|とうだい}きって⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ are particularly common set phrases used as high praise.
